title: Fix Terra Vedant Tech logo not displaying in the site header

requirements.text: Ensure the Terra Vedant Tech logo image files exist and are served from the exact static paths referenced by the app: `/assets/generated/terravedant-logo.dim_128x128.png` and `/assets/generated/terravedant-logo.dim_512x512.png` (i.e., placed under `frontend/public/assets/generated/` with those exact filenames and correct casing).

quotes: Logo is not displayed in the page

acceptanceCriteria: Loading `/assets/generated/terravedant-logo.dim_128x128.png` directly in the browser returns HTTP 200 (not 404) in both local dev and deployed build.

requirements.text: Add a resilient logo rendering behavior in `frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx` so the header does not appear broken when the logo fails to load (e.g., add an `onError` fallback to swap to `BRAND_ASSETS.logo.large` and/or show a text-only brand mark if both fail).

quotes: Logo is not displayed in the page

acceptanceCriteria: If `/assets/generated/terravedant-logo.dim_128x128.png` fails to load, the header still shows a visible brand mark (fallback image or text) without throwing runtime errors.
When the logo file exists, the image renders at all responsive breakpoints currently supported by the header (mobile, tablet, desktop).

constraints: Do not modify any files under `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, or anything inside `frontend/src/components/ui` (these are immutable).
Keep asset references as absolute paths starting with `/assets/...` (do not route images through the backend).
nonGoals: Do not change backend logic or add new backend features (logo display is a frontend/static-asset concern).
Do not redesign the site header layout beyond what is needed to make the logo reliably visible.

required: Square logo artwork on a clean background (terravedant-logo.dim_128x128.png, 128x128)
Square logo artwork on a clean background (terravedant-logo.dim_512x512.png, 512x512)
